title: Set several layers to the same one-off color in one go
goal: Right now picking several layers lets you set them all to a saved, named color, but not to a plain color you just choose. Select three boxes, open one color well, and paint all three.
notes: Follow-up from queue/audits/2026-09-03-multi-style.json. The whole-selection reading is already there: EditorState.colorStyleSelection(slot:) and ColorStyleSelection in PhotonzCore. What is missing is the write: a one-off color has to go through the right builder per slot (AnnotationBuilder.restyled for a shape stroke or fill, TextBuilder.restyled for text ink, GroupContent.backgroundHex for a frame), which is why this was cut from the style slice. Layer.setColorHex(_:for:) already routes all three and is what bindColorStyle uses, so a document-level setColorHex(layerIDs:slot:hex:) plus one EditorState perform is probably the whole job. The row is ColorStyleRow in Sources/Photonz/ColorStylePanel.swift; its no-well init is the one the SelectionColorInspector uses.
acceptance: With more than one layer selected, the Color section offers a color well as well as the styles menu
Picking a color in it paints every selected layer that has that kind of color, in one undo step
A selection whose colors differ still says Mixed until a color is picked

log.note: Adversarial review before building. The idea holds: a person who picks three boxes and wants them blue has no move today (Save as Style is refused when they differ, and one at a time is three moves plus an undo each), so the well is the missing half of a row that already speaks for the whole selection. Shortest version wins: no new section and no new control, just make the readout the row already draws into the thing you click. Cut from the mock-ish version: a separate Apply button, a second Fill section, and a swatch-plus-word layout that would have needed the readout column widened past what a 264pt dock can spare. Two real hazards found. (1) A row whose layers ALL wear one style must not grow a well: the app's rule everywhere else is that a styled color is edited on the shelf, not on the layer, so that reading keeps its plain swatch and Unlink stays the way out. (2) A Mixed row can hold layers that wear a style, and painting them while leaving the binding on would mean the next edit to that style silently repaints a color somebody chose by hand. So painting takes those layers off their style, and the row says so in words BEFORE the click rather than after.

Built and verified. Core: PhotonzDocument.setColorHex(layerIDs:slot:hex:) paints exactly the layers the row speaks for (locked layers and switched-off fills sit out, so the row's promise and the pick can never drift), and takes any of them off a style in that slot, because a color chosen by hand is the layer's own. ColorStyleSelection.unlinkNote is the sentence the row says before the click when that would happen. App: SelectionColorWell in ColorStylePanel.swift is the readout AND the control (a 264pt dock has no room for both) - a swatch when they agree, the word Mixed as a chip when they do not, both opening the app's own picker so a color lands on a deliberate action rather than every drag tick; EditorState.setSelectionColor does it in one perform. Nine new core tests; the full suite is green at 2207. Live in the probe app via Scripts/playtest/selection-color-walk.json (new action paintSelectionColor): three boxes -> one color -> fill #B0184A x3, ONE undo puts all three back, a selection holding one styled layer reads mixed x3, and painting it drops Accent to 0 uses. Real captures in queue/audits/2026-09-03-selection-color.json. Not verified by automation: the click that opens the picker, because the loop has no Accessibility grant and a walk can only reach the picture, not the dock - said plainly in the audit's rough.

The whole-selection Color row now has a well: pick several layers, click the Fill or Outline swatch (or the word Mixed), choose a color, and every picked layer that has that kind of color takes it in one undo step, letting go of any style in that slot with the row saying so first. Core PhotonzDocument.setColorHex(layerIDs:slot:hex:) + ColorStyleSelection.unlinkNote, app SelectionColorWell + EditorState.setSelectionColor, Next only. 9 new core tests, full suite green at 2207, driven live in the probe app by Scripts/playtest/selection-color-walk.json. Audit: queue/audits/2026-09-03-selection-color.json with real captures.
